name: PACCAR
sub: Peterbilt and Kenworth chassis under autonomous freight
about: Truck OEM behind Peterbilt and Kenworth platforms used in autonomous freight testing and customer-owned autonomous deployments.
model: Truck manufacturing, parts, finance, and connected services.
deployment: Peterbilt and Kenworth tractors appear in several autonomous trucking programs, including Aurora and Kodiak-related deployments.
metrics: Autonomous truck programs continue to use OEM Class 8 platforms rather than wholly bespoke trucks.
signal: Important because autonomous trucking scale depends on OEM-grade redundant chassis and dealer/service networks.
